history_lead: Results tied to the code, the profile and the rules used, for this workspace only.
history_empty: This workspace has no validations yet. Choose what to validate to create the first one.
history_pick_second: Choose one more validation to compare.
history_baseline_set: The run {runId} is the baseline of this workspace.
history_baseline_cleared: The run {runId} is no longer the baseline.
history_preserve_set: The run {runId} is kept out of retention cleanup.
history_preserve_cleared: The run {runId} is subject to retention again.
history_compare_comparable: Both runs used the same policy, the same rules and the same scope.
history_compare_not_comparable: These runs cannot be compared like for like. The lists below exist, but do not read them as a clean difference.
history_warning_POLICY_CHANGED: The policy differs between the two runs.
history_warning_RULES_CHANGED: The rules, tools or configuration differ between the two runs.
history_warning_SCOPE_CHANGED: The scope differs between the two runs.
history_warning_REDUCED_RUN: One of the runs switched checks off only for that round: it is a partial round.
history_warning_BASELINE_PARTIAL: The older run did not finish.
history_context_body: A change in the code or in the configuration requires a new validation. No old result approves a new commit.
